This self-test checks the background that CSCI 201 assumes from its first week:
programming from CSCI 141 and 145,
and the algebra from your math prerequisite.
It is not graded,
and nobody sees your answers.

Work each exercise on paper,
without notes or a calculator,
before you open its solution.
The whole test takes about 45 minutes.
Only your final answers need checking,
but work that you can follow helps you find a mistake.
Each solution explains the answer
and names a page to review if you missed the exercise.
The code is in Python.
The course itself programs in Racket,
which it teaches from the start.

Your results tell you what to do next:

- If you got almost everything right,
  you are ready.
- If you missed a few exercises,
  read the review pages that their solutions name
  before the first week.
- If you missed several exercises in one part,
  send me a message through the Canvas inbox in the first week,
  and we will plan how you can catch up.
